name: Codex
description: Manage local Codex sessions, workspaces and Baijimu LLM credentials in one application.

remoteCapabilities.name: codex.project.read
remoteCapabilities.description: Read local Codex project roots from Codex desktop state, trusted project config, and thread cwd metadata.

remoteCapabilities.name: codex.thread.read
remoteCapabilities.description: Read, list, and search local Codex thread metadata and streamed output.

remoteCapabilities.name: codex.app.read
remoteCapabilities.description: List Codex app-server apps/connectors visible to the local Codex account.

remoteCapabilities.name: codex.turn.write
remoteCapabilities.description: Send prompts and steering instructions to local Codex.

remoteCapabilities.name: codex.raw.request
remoteCapabilities.description: Forward an advanced JSON-RPC request to local Codex app-server.
